title: Deliver v0.5.57 performance capability to future adopters

acceptance: A full HTTPS GitHub repository URL is canonicalized once and is used by both release verification and release-digests hydration; malformed forms fail closed before target writes.

Focused regressions prove the full HTTPS hydration URL is https://github.com/spirex-ds-dev/ai-cockpit-template/releases/download/v0.5.57/release-digests.json, never a nested invalid URL, and preserve negative-path failure behavior.
Strict local quality, release preparation/rehearsal, and hosted PR verification pass without reducing tests, coverage, security, installer, release, Outcome, JUnit, or failure-evidence gates.
Actual v0.5.57 publication binds an immutable tag, source archive, SBOM, provenance, installer digest, release-digests asset, published projection, and workflow receipt to one release identity.

A fresh temporary Git repository installs v0.5.57 using AI_COCKPIT_TEMPLATE_REPO=https://github.com/spirex-ds-dev/ai-cockpit-template.git and records the v0.5.57 identity before target writes; only then may #783 close.
The performance capability already merged in #795 is demonstrably obtainable by a future adopter via the published v0.5.57 installation path.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: The performance improvement is merged but not yet safely deliverable to future adopters because the full-HTTPS public installer path has a divergent release-digests URL construction and the repository published release projection remains stale after v0.5.56. A public installer must make the correct new version discoverable and installable without requiring an adopter to infer local tag or JSON inconsistencies.
constraints: Preserve immutable historical releases including v0.5.56.
Do not reduce coverage below 85.10%, test collection size, security gates, release gates, or failure evidence.
Use source-bound receipts and a real public black-box future-adopter installation; a successful local cache is not proof.
The user's recorded approval covers required bounded confirmations, writes, PRs, merge, publication, issue closure, and local/remote cleanup, but never bypasses a gate.
intent.rationale: A canonical repository identity shared by verification and hydration eliminates the divergence at its source. A new immutable patch release with independently bound assets and a fresh installation is the only truthful way to deliver the performance benefit after immutable v0.5.56 evidence proved inadequate.

rawUserRequest: 目标是把收益交付给 adopter。不是现成已有的具体某个项目，是未来安装的对象工程。到发布最新版本为止，做好优化和自检。完成全部工单为止不要停。要确认的，我授权给你，并写入contract。
